unit.title: A proper apology
canDo: Give a cause using 由于 / 因为
Offer a consequence and repair with 因此
Keep an explanation separate from an excuse

example.zh: 由于地址写错，朋友走错了地方。
example.py: yóu yú dì zhǐ xiě cuò , péng you zǒu cuò le dì fāng .
example.en: Because the address was wrong, the friend went to the wrong place.

grammar.explanation: 由于地址写错 can introduce a cause noun phrase or clause. 因为我写错地址 directly identifies an agent and cause. 由于 is often more written; do not use it to obscure responsibility. A cause can explain a delay without excusing it. This unit concerns an incorrect address, not a real accident.

examples.zh: 由于地址写错，朋友走错了地方。
examples.py: yóu yú dì zhǐ xiě cuò , péng you zǒu cuò le dì fāng .
examples.en: Because the address was wrong, the friend went to the wrong place.

examples.zh: 因为我写错地址，你多走了一段。
examples.py: yīn wèi wǒ xiě cuò dì zhǐ , nǐ duō zǒu le yī duàn .
examples.en: Because I wrote the wrong address, you travelled farther.

examples.zh: 因为没核对，我发了旧通知。
examples.py: yīn wèi méi hé duì , wǒ fā le jiù tōng zhī .
examples.en: Because I did not check, I sent the old notice.

commonMistakes.wrong: 由于你看了我写错的地址，所以是你的问题。
commonMistakes.right: 因为我写错地址，让你多走了一段，对不起。
commonMistakes.why: Name the actual cause without shifting responsibility.

grammar.purpose: Connect cause and consequence without inventing completion
grammar.explanation: 由于地址错了，因此需要发新地址 states a consequence and needed action, not proof that the new address has been sent. Compare 已经发送 with 现在要发送. 因此 is a concise written connector; 所以 is frequent conversationally. The consequence should follow from the stated cause, not from blame unrelated to the facts.

examples.zh: 地址错了，所以朋友多走了一段。
examples.py: dì zhǐ cuò le , suǒ yǐ péng you duō zǒu le yī duàn .
examples.en: The address was wrong, so the friend travelled farther.

examples.zh: 我漏了门牌号，因此现在补上。
examples.py: wǒ lòu le mén pái hào , yīn cǐ xiàn zài bǔ shàng .
examples.en: I omitted the building number, so I add it now.

examples.zh: 由于通知有错，所以先停止传播旧通知。
examples.py: yóu yú tōng zhī yǒu cuò , suǒ yǐ xiān tíng zhǐ chuán bō jiù tōng zhī .
examples.en: Because the notice is wrong, stop circulating the old one first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 需要补上，所以已经补好了。
commonMistakes.right: 需要补上，因此我现在补。
commonMistakes.why: A necessary repair is not evidence of a completed repair.

dialogue.title: The apology is not a defence speech
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the error, the consequence and the actual repair.

lines.zh: 你怎么到了另一个门口？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me dào le lìng yī gè mén kǒu ?
lines.en: How did you end up at the other entrance?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你发的地址是旧的，我多走了一段。
lines.py: nǐ fā de dì zhǐ shì jiù de , wǒ duō zǒu le yī duàn .
lines.en: The address you sent was old, and I travelled farther.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对不起，因为我没核对，发了旧地址。
lines.py: duì bù qǐ , yīn wèi wǒ méi hé duì , fā le jiù dì zhǐ .
lines.en: Sorry; because I did not check, I sent the old address.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 刚才你只说我应该早一点出发，我有点伤心。
lines.py: gāng cái nǐ zhǐ shuō wǒ yīng gāi zǎo yī diǎn chū fā , wǒ yǒu diǎn shāng xīn .
lines.en: Just now you only said I should have left earlier; I felt a little hurt.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 是我的错误，不是你的问题。我现在发正确地址。
lines.py: shì wǒ de cuò wù , bù shì nǐ de wèn tí . wǒ xiàn zài fā zhèng què dì zhǐ .
lines.en: It was my error, not your fault. I will send the correct address now.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还有门牌号，别漏了。
lines.py: hái yǒu mén pái hào , bié lòu le .
lines.en: Include the building number too; do not omit it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，相关信息一起发。下次发送前再核对。
lines.py: hǎo , xiāng guān xìn xī yì qǐ fā . xià cì fā sòng qián zài hé duì .
lines.en: Okay; I will send the relevant information together and check again before sending next time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢，先把通知改好。
lines.py: xiè xiè , xiān bǎ tōng zhī gǎi hǎo .
lines.en: Thanks; correct the notice first.
lines.speaker: b

choices: It accepts responsibility and proposes a concrete repair
It claims the old address never existed
questions.answer: It accepts responsibility and proposes a concrete repair

questions.q: Why did the friend travel farther?

choices: No, it is a future intention

reading.title: A cause and a responsibility
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read what is known and what remains to be done.

lines.zh: 由于我没核对地址，朋友到了旧门口，多走了一段。
lines.py: yóu yú wǒ méi hé duì dì zhǐ , péng you dào le jiù mén kǒu , duō zǒu le yī duàn .
lines.en: Because I did not check the address, my friend reached the old entrance and travelled farther.

lines.zh: 这次事件没有人受伤，但朋友的时间被浪费了。
lines.py: zhè cì shì jiàn méi yǒu rén shòu shāng , dàn péng you de shí jiān bèi làng fèi le .
lines.en: No one was injured in this incident, but the friend’s time was wasted.

lines.zh: 我先听她的反应，再表达道歉，不把后果当她的问题。
lines.py: wǒ xiān tīng tā de fǎn yìng , zài biǎo dá dào qiàn , bù bǎ hòu guǒ dāng tā de wèn tí .
lines.en: I listen to her response before apologizing, without treating the consequence as her fault.

lines.zh: 通知漏了门牌号，因此现在补上并发送正确地址。
lines.py: tōng zhī lòu le mén pái hào , yīn cǐ xiàn zài bǔ shàng bìng fā sòng zhèng què dì zhǐ .
lines.en: The notice omitted the building number, so I add it now and send the correct address.

lines.zh: 发生了错误，消息消失也不能假装没发生。
lines.py: fā shēng le cuò wù , xiāo xī xiāo shī yě bù néng jiǎ zhuāng méi fā shēng .
lines.en: An error happened; even if the message disappears, do not pretend it did not happen.

lines.zh: 旧通知需要修正，不能宣布一个未经确认的新地点。
lines.py: jiù tōng zhī xū yào xiū zhèng , bù néng xuān bù yī gè wèi jīng què rèn de xīn dì diǎn .
lines.en: The old notice needs correcting; do not announce an unconfirmed new venue.

lines.zh: 我把信息弄乱了，就要认真对待修正，不急着说信任已经恢复。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ xìn xī nòng luàn le , jiù yào rèn zhēn duì dài xiū zhèng , bù jí zhe shuō xìn rèn yǐ jīng huī fù .
lines.en: I confused the information and must take correction seriously, without rushing to say trust has already recovered.

lines.zh: 完善通知是一次修正，下次发送前还要注意核对。
lines.py: wán shàn tōng zhī shì yī cì xiū zhèng , xià cì fā sòng qián hái yào zhù yì hé duì .
lines.en: Improving the notice is one repair; next time still check before sending.

questions.q: Does deleting a message erase the incident?
choices: Only if the old notice is gone

lines.zh: 【由于】我没核对地址，朋友到了旧门口，多走了一段。
lines.py: yóu yú wǒ méi hé duì dì zhǐ , péng you dào le jiù mén kǒu , duō zǒu le yī duàn .
lines.en: Because I did not check the address, my friend reached the old entrance and travelled farther.

lines.zh: 通知漏了门牌号，【因此】现在补上并发送正确地址。
lines.py: tōng zhī lòu le mén pái hào , yīn cǐ xiàn zài bǔ shàng bìng fā sòng zhèng què dì zhǐ .
lines.en: The notice omitted the building number, so I add it now and send the correct address.
